transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for offering to help with the plant-sitting. Let me lay out what we're working with. The owner is away July 1 through July 14, and we have three plants: a jade plant that needs strong direct light, an orchid that needs bright indirect light and humidity, and a Boston fern that does best in shade and steady moisture. I have a sunny south-facing sunroom at my place, and both Marco and Talia have offered to keep plants at their homes. The orchid specifically needs watering on July 2, July 6, July 10, and July 14 per the owner's care card. Before I make final assignments, I'd like to hear from Marco and Talia about what conditions you can offer at your homes — particularly light exposure and humidity — so I can match each plant to the right spot for the full two weeks.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have a humid bathroom with bright indirect light that would work well for the orchid. However, I want to be upfront that I'll be away from July 6 through July 8, so I wouldn't be able to water the orchid on July 6 myself. Lena, would you be able to cover that July 6 watering if the orchid stays at my place?
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share something important about my home setup. My cat chews on jade leaves, so the jade plant really can't safely stay at my place — it would be at risk the whole time. However, I do have a shaded porch that would be perfect for the Boston fern, since it needs shade and steady moisture and that spot provides exactly that.
